description.text: The major is designed to train professionals with basic theory of art design and advanced digital production technology, who are talents in independent network design and visual communication design. It actively develops creative potential in the students, enhances their thinking of combination of technology and art, improves network planning advertising, product packaging, planning, business planning and overall image of products such as creative design capabilities and ability to innovate. Students after graduation can work in the field of art planning, production and research and management in network operating companies, advertising, computer video entertainment product development and production companies, or arts and cultural sectors in the related. The major stresses the integration of the high-tech with modern art. It closely integrates digital media with creative industries, cultivating all-round art design personnel of planning, and production.

duration.text: The Artistic Design at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
